title: ticfac skills install/get default to the ticfac skill when no name is given
description: Operator, 2026-10-07: 'ticfac skills install ticfac' repeats itself — the binary embeds one skill. Make the name optional for install and get: with no name, use the ticfac skill; keep the explicit form working (and the error when a named skill does not exist). Update the skill text, README and help to show the short form.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac skills install and ticfac skills get with no name act on the ticfac skill; the named form still works; help/skill/README show the short form; tests; make gate
